Principal’s Welcome
Our specialist school in Oxford is for children and young people aged between 8 and 19 with autism and severe learning difficulties who benefit from an autism specific environment. Developed in partnership with MacIntyre Academies Trust and Oxfordshire County Council, Endeavour was established to meet the needs of local students and their families. A day in the life of...
Arrival
At the beginning of the school day, staff welcome pupils from their taxis or across from Endeavour House and make sure everyone feels settled before the day begins
Class based learning
The class sizes are small and set up for pupils to have plenty of space to move around and work in a way that works for them. Visual symbols around the school supports the independence of the pupils.
Outdoors Learning
Pupils spend lots of time outdoors both using the equipment in the school grounds and going for trips out and about in the local area.
Assembly time
We celebrate pupil achievement and recognise cultural events as a whole school. The time is supported by staff to be as relaxed as possible for all pupils.
Occupational Therapy
Pupils have access to school based Occupational Therapy support.
End of the school day
Staff support pupils to make a smooth transition at the end of the school day.

Essential Information
SEN Information Report
SEN Information Report
SEN Information Report
When seeking a new school we understand that parents and carers will have a wide range of questions and need the relevant information to decide which school is the most appropriate for their child.
This SEND Information Report outlines information regarding ways in which we provide support for all our learners in order for them to learn and grow intellectually, emotionally and socially in a nurturing environment.
The information required to be included in the SEND Information Report is stated in the Special Educational Needs and Disability Regulations 2015 Schedule 1: Information to be included in the SEND information report. This can be found at:http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1530/schedule/1/made
We fully comply with: SEND Code of Practice January 2015, Equality Act 2010 and the Children and Families Act 2014. This page has information to answer some of the questions or concerns you may have and the rest of the website will tell you more about what is on offer to your child. Following consultation with families during our last Family Forum Event we will be adding pictures and video links to this section of our website.
For further information about the local authority offer please click the link below Oxfordshire SEND local offer | Oxfordshire County Council
For any other questions please contact the school by telephone on 01865 767766.

A great end to the week - Another Competent Practitioner in Intensive Interaction
Another member of staff joins our team of Intensive Interaction Practitioners.
Congratulations to Sheena who reflected on feedback during her training and fine-tuned her skills to create this beautiful moment. Her gentle playful approach and ability to notice the young person's subtle gestures meant that their non-verbal communication was received and valued without any demands or pressure. Notice how the young person gently touches Sheena's finger to communicate that he wanted her to stay in the moment.
Please click here for more moments like these.
